revision_reason: First v1 normal fixture stopped after its half-step forecast exceeded 180 seconds. Preserve it as unresolved; no physical threshold, step size or completed record changes.
resource_basis: Completed full-step forecasts took 93.16, 93.16 and 127.56 seconds. Double the longest completed cost for the half-step check plus bounded headroom; 300 seconds per forecast remains inside the unchanged 600-second batch and 2400-second flight limits.
question: Can visual observation, seeded plant faults, report-informed recovery judgment and symptom-controlled return share one exact-state mission and evidence index?

preflight_acceptance.normal: visual confirmation followed by exact-state nominal return; no false symptom intervention
preflight_acceptance.propulsion_80: symptom observation, requested tracking, checked adoption and contact limits
preflight_acceptance.sensor_gain_80: requested tracking, checked unchanged assumption and contact limits
preflight_acceptance.payload_jam: image/telemetry-based stop; retained inventory and its full mass preserved in the nominal return path
preflight_acceptance.unknown_inventory: return inhibited and unresolved; never a mission-completion success

private_schedule_policy: seed, fault identity, severity and future trigger schedule never enter model requests
qualification: new experimental composition; nominal 39-case qualification is not extended or edited
catch: history is supplied as judgment evidence; capture dispatch remains rejected until trajectory reachability and mechanical support are independently demonstrated
unsupported: combined retained payloads and propulsion fault
live: requires successful new fixture evidence, a separately registered native image evaluation and approval of an exact live plan
storage: fresh output per plan, one common index, raw frames and traces under flight/, no automatic deletion or overwrite
